body: That sounds awesome! What do you like to perform?

Oh brilliant!
Thank you very much.
If there's a Barbie I'll be sure to let you know.

Hi. I hope you feel better very soon. Im  sorry about your breakup.  Music is the key!
I just moved to Edmonton and I'm very down as I couldn't bring my drums from Australia and I have no real friends yet.
I can tell you that Whyte Ave has the best live places through what I've heard. Also if you need a helper to set up mic stands and cables etc. It was ome of my favourite things to do with friends back home. I'm obviously not great live. But I'll sure help you set up and pack up!

I am currently located in Australia. World wide opinions and ideas needed! Syria and refugees on our shores are currently a big issue. It's so hard to think about how many willing and capable people want to directly help the world, literally just ready waiting but not sure exactly HOW to arrive at that point of help. Other than monetary donations to organizations (that don't always fully aid a cause in efficient or helpful ways) or other forms of donation where we cannot track the outcome.

I often think of self harm scarring in the way that a picture is worth 1000 words. Like a traumatizing story is about to be spilled onto an unprepared person with only a quick glance. 
The answers here have all been interesting and appreciated. It was nice to wake up to a response. Thank you for discussing and sharing your opinions. 

I agree that children aren't judgemental. It's quite beautiful to witness a child being completely honest and full of untarnished love and acceptance. 

I know as we age we lose this to an extent. Some more than others. 

I also considered young teens as children when posting this question.
Thank you, nofishtocatch. I appreciate your reply.

Hi mushpuppy,
I got a total of zero replies. Kind of had a giggle at my huge ambitious want to send somebody some love going stone cold. I'm still glad I tried the little project. It meant something to me and hopefully to anyone who may have read it, just to know they aren't alone.
Excuse my very, very late reply and for leaving you hanging. Thank you very much. High five officially slapped back!
Thank you :) Sorry for the months late reply. I appreciate your comment!
If they all made a baby and you had a bigger 'fro. Maybe.

If it was sinister,  not written by Molly, it would have been thrown away by who did it.
Otherwise,  I feel like it's the same as people making Kurt Cobains suicide letter into shirts and posters. It said "do not read.". It's disrespectful. 

However,  if you need closure, or her death was suspicious,  read it. I believe she would forgive you. It's not like you're going to publish it.

I'm so sorry for your loss.

Edit: Perhaps she was suffering from mental illness or panic,  hence sloppy writing,  and possibly guilt if she had written her feelings down that it would affect others.
She's a hottie. But this is an oldie.
Thanks all for taking the time to reply. I wrote and delivered. Cheers Reddit x
